verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside the PlayCanvas Editor. Tasks can still be delegated to an external AI assistant: the official Editor MCP Server connects it to an open Editor session, where it can modify project data and verify results in the viewport or a running app. New projects also ship PlayCanvas Skills for compatible AI coding agents. Missing for 10: a native in-product AI assistant (no extra tools required), documentation of an in-Editor chat or agent UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of delegated task workflows.
